concepts.design: 차분한 흑단발, 자주빛 눈, 아이보리 블라우스와 네이비 와이드 팬츠
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one fully clothed fictional adult woman, age 28, mature romance visual novel heroine Yujin concept. Input1 is ONLY adult curvy body scale and relaxed upright pose reference, NOT clothes and NOT hair; redesign the face, hair, outfit entirely. Input2 is ONLY rendering style reference: very clean thin contours, expressive large anime eyes, restrained soft two-tone cel skin, clean hair shadow masses, controlled highlights. Do not copy Ria's identity, hairstyle, colors, outfit. Match this rendering over the WHOLE body. Attractive warm adult, confident femininity, softly attentive direct gaze, natural unpainted lips and no makeup. Preserve mature hourglass silhouette and plausible adult limb proportions. Full figure head to shoes centered portrait 1024x1536, safe empty margins at top/bottom, front view, shoulders level, arms down relaxed next to thighs, hands unobstructed. Readable anatomical 5 digits per hand including a thumb, natural separate rounded fingertips and small clean nails. Ears with one helix and lobe, no extra bumps, at most one simple tiny earring per lobe, no duplicated hardware. Outfit must be fully finished, coherent stitching/fasteners, sober polished fashion, no logos. No bags, handheld objects, glasses, hats, watches, fantasy ears, school uniform. TRUE transparent background; no painted gray, glow, floor, shadows behind body, aura, text, watermark or comparison panels. One complete single sprite only. Face and hairstyle design must follow this individual concept, not reuse the existing Yujin or Ria face.
Concept 06: Longer elegant adult oval with softly defined cheekbones and small rounded chin; open plum-violet almond eyes, low calm brows, petite nose, softly lifted closed smile. Glossy black chin-length inward-curled bob, deep side part with swept fringe, one ear tuck.
New outfit: Ivory draped V-neck short-sleeve blouse with tasteful neckline, tucked into tailored high-waist navy wide-leg full-length trousers, narrow dark belt with small gold buckle, burgundy pointed pumps. Sophisticated approachable city professional.
